name: mstack-web-ui
description: Builds and reviews web interfaces, modern web platform features and Manifest V3 Chrome extensions. Every page, screen, component or form it builds meets a floor: it works with a keyboard and on a phone, every control has a readable name and its states, every data view handles no data, loading, an error and long content, and motion is used with restraint. A new page with no design system gets a direction that is chosen and stated, not the default look, and nothing in it is invented. In an existing project the design system, components and stack win over every default of the skill. Covers modern HTML/CSS/JS with Baseline Widely Available and fallback rules, Web Components, CWV performance, client web security and Passkeys, privacy, PWA install, browser Built-in AI, WebMCP, WebAssembly, Chrome Extensions MV3, and React rules matched to the installed React version. A review returns ranked findings with file and line and changes nothing. Text only: no script, no data and nothing to install. One skill for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity.
